  - `Second::per(Day)` (returns `u32`, `u64`, `u128`, `usize`, `i32`, `i64`, `i128`, `isize`, `f32`, or `f64`)
  - `Second::per(Week)` (returns `u32`, `u64`, `u128`, `usize`, `i32`, `i64`, `i128`, `isize`, `f32`, or `f64`)
